title: Argentinian-Style Smoked Chicken Fajitas
description: Smoky, roasted chicken breast in a Mexican-inspired dish, served with meal prep in a bowl.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with smoked paprika, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, toss together the roasted green peppers, onion, and garlic.
In a separate bowl, mix together the olive oil, chili powder, and smoked paprika.
Place the chicken breast in a separate bowl and brush the olive oil mixture on top.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, add the bowl with the peppers and onion to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken and peppers from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken and serve with the roasted peppers and onion.
Serve in a bowl with your favorite Mexican-inspired toppings.
